definitions.explanation: A question word asking about the identity of a person.

examples.japanese: {誰|だれ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
{誰|だれ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ノックしています→ノック：03868_nokku⟧。{誰|だれ}⟦だろう→だろう：09576_darou⟧？
examples.english: Someone is knocking on the door. I wonder who it is?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{誰|だれ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{誰|だれ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}っています→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Who is this person in the photo? My friends say that none of them know.

notes:
{誰|だれ} is one of the fundamental question words, used to ask about the identity of a person.

POLITENESS LEVELS:
- {誰|だれ}: standard/casual
- ⟦どなた→どなた：02923_donata⟧: polite form (used with customers, superiors)
- ⟦どちらさま→どちら様：22795_dochirasama⟧: very polite (formal situations)

DERIVED EXPRESSIONS:
- {誰|だれ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: someone, somebody
- {誰|だれ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ + negative: no one, nobody
- {誰|だれ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ + positive: everyone (literary)
- {誰|だれ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: anyone, everybody

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {誰|だれ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + verb: Who did X?
- {誰|だれ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun: Whose X?
- {誰|だれ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: to whom?

USAGE:
In indirect questions, {誰|だれ} can appear mid-sentence: {誰|だれ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (I don't know who's coming).
